messages.text:
"Create a completely NEW mobile-only fantasy MMORPG called AETHERIA from scratch.

GRAPHICS: Use beautiful HD 2.5D isometric pixel art graphics. Fixed camera angled diagonally from above, following the player. Detailed environments, smaller characters, smooth animations and rich fantasy colors. Optimize for Android smartphones.

CHARACTER CREATION: Players choose male or female, enter their own unique character name, select Angels or Demons and choose one of three classes:

- Warrior: strong melee fighter.
- Mage: powerful magic and ranged attacks.
- Assassin: fast attacks and critical damage.

Include hairstyles, hair colors, eye colors, three starting outfits and a character preview. Angels have celestial wings, Demons have demonic wings.

WORLD: Eight regions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Include Dawnshire, Stonewatch, Sunmarket and Frosthaven.

GAMEPLAY: Real-time combat, normal attacks, class skills, auto-attack, HP/MP, potions, experience, leveling, respawning monsters, quests, dungeons and bosses. Each class has unique weapons, armor and a main skill upgradeable to level 10.

EQUIPMENT AND LOOT: 9 equipment slots. Direct drop chances: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%. All direct drops are T3. Purple and higher never drop directly.

CRAFTING AND FUSION: Combine 4 identical items: T3 to T2, T2 to T1, T1 to next rarity T3. No random item destruction. Craft Legendary using rare materials, recipes and boss drops. Four Legendary create Mythic; four Mythic create Divine. Mythic and Divine never drop directly. Boss stones have up to 3 bonuses. Critical chance capped at 50%.

ECONOMY: Gathering, crafting, materials, recipes, blacksmiths, merchants, storage, Gold, Gems and player marketplace. Configurable prices for crafting, fusion, potions and teleportation. No repair system.

QUESTS AND NPCS: Main and side quests, rewards and interactive NPCs. Starting village has blacksmith, merchant, quest NPC, storage NPC and teleporter.

SHOP: Costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, faction wings, Gems and optional premium membership. Wings are quest or shop rewards only, never dropped, traded or fused. Gems are also earnable through gameplay. Free-to-play without mandatory purchases.

MOBILE UI: Virtual joystick, attack and skill buttons, interaction, mount, auto-attack, HP/MP bars, minimap, inventory, equipment, quests, shop and character profile. All text in English.

DEVELOPMENT IN TWO PHASES:
Phase 1: Character creation, factions, classes, starting village, first region, movement, combat, monsters, inventory, equipment and basic quests.
Phase 2: Remaining regions, crafting, fusion, marketplace, economy, dungeons, bosses, shop, mounts, pets, wings and world events.

Prepare for future real multiplayer, accounts and persistent data. Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.

Build a playable mobile game, not a mockup. Use modular code, optimize for smartphones, test features and fix errors. (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
